newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market very slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market very slow - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for a market test, USDA said. Inquiry was moderate and demand fair.
Sales confirmed on 200 slaughter steers and 200 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 18,600 head confirmed, mostly previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Pen Select to mostly Choice 1200 lbs 70.50 (Certified Hereford); pen Select with end Choice 1250 lbs 68.50.
Slaughter heifers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs
69.00; pen Select with end Choice 1100 lbs 68.00.
Confirmed - 400 last week - 25,500 last year - none
Wk to date - 18,600 last week - 43,900 last year - 97,000
